blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Choco Mucho finally ended more than a year of absence in the PVL All-Filipino Conference semifinals after ousting PLDT in a do-or-die duel, 25-22, 25-23, 18-25, 25-23, to complete the 2026 Siklab Series Final Four on Thursday at Mall of Asia Arena. With their backs against the wall, the Flying Titans overcame another tough challenge to return to the semifinals for the first time since the 2024-25 All-Filipino Conference.
